label: S74: 15Oct26
checklist: Consolidate the reply instructions into one shared core
REPLY_CORE shared by the led and spoken paths. 1754 words to 1406, and a contradiction between 'under 180 words' and 'under 140' resolved.
Progressive status while a turn is working
components/turn-progress. Labels are the real phases; timings were estimates until the two-stage reply replaced the last one with a fact.
Drafts stop leaving blanks for facts already on file
First name and date of birth reach the writer. turn_context patched in place rather than replayed, which would have deleted four blocks added since 1 Oct.
A log resolves a pending C-SSRS question whatever tier it drew. Her call, against my proposal: 'if there was something wrong, a user would respond with a log.'
Sonnet 5 dropped the NHS number. Measured and refused rather than shipped for the 2.7s.
She almost put the app away over it. Guard at the write, done in arithmetic after Haiku and Sonnet both altered words and Opus cost 9s.
Fourth cache breakpoint on a led turn
Reply call cached read 36.5k to 42.4k. Smaller than the harness predicted and the commit says so: the tool result is 7,400 tokens no cache can reach.
What the app DID is published ~7s in and shown while the words are still being written. Additive, no new endpoint, no streaming.
Instrument which classifier fields are ever used
Names only, never values. Silently recorded nothing for an afternoon until a CHECK constraint was found by asking the live app.
Report: a plan reads as a plan
Five movements were arriving as one run-on paragraph in the document she takes to her specialist. The structure existed and the last function flattened it.
A movement with no video gets written instructions
13 of 45 movements had a demonstration. 32 described, so all 45 can now be watched or read. Her knee plan went 1 of 5 to 5 of 5.
The week is read against her own usual
Four-week baseline, and the quiet stretch is checked against her care record before it counts as unexplained. The knee referral was dated the same day the training stopped.
Swipe to delete on Me, and from chat. The app had told her it could not.
Her own name is not a standing detail
Blocked at the write and the instruction that offered 'a date of birth' as an example removed.
The chat can see which movements have a video
Plans block marks every movement [video] or [words only]. It had been asking her to go and check.
x-selodia-prompt plus scripts/inventory-prompt.mjs. First call reads 117,910 characters. GENERAL_CONDUCT is 68% and holds 59 instructions.
Build an eval the cutting must get past
13 cases, every one a failure she has actually had, every check proved able to fail. Safety is reported separately, never averaged in.
SAVING TO THE ALMANAC 11,554 to 10,412. Duplication of the tool removed, then two worked examples tightened. Eval unmoved both times.
Found a live bug instead of fat: the prompt still said it cannot tell which movements have a demonstration, contradicting the fix made three hours earlier.

Root cause found: a shared Dropbox folder counts against the recipient's quota and 1,650 videos will never fit a free account. No token was ever going to fix it. Email sent to the vendor from Selodia.
Nothing raised, applied for or spent beyond running costs. Women in Innovation readiness still tracked by the Monday task; the director's loan account still has no card.
decisions: Decision
Date
Reasoning
A guard goes in the code, not a second ask in the prompt
The wall-of-text rule already existed and was obeyed three times out of four. A rule obeyed three times and ignored once is not a rule. Her standing note: enforce it where the row is written.
The layout repair is arithmetic, not a model call

Measured: Haiku dropped a word from an exercise, Sonnet returned nothing, Opus kept every word at 9s and Opus prices on a turn whose latency is already the complaint. Breaking a paragraph needs no judgement.
Two-stage reply over shortening the turn
Her call, and her reason: the second model call 'is literally what's building what I want'. So the turn is not shortened, it is split.
Written instructions before preferring filmed movements
Her call. Choosing an exercise because it was filmed is the tail wagging the dog, and a knee programme being signed off by a consultant must not be bent towards the asset library.
The caution moves below the movement on a plan card
Reverses Part Ten. That rule held while the demonstration was a video she could already picture; it stopped holding once the how-to became the thing she opens the card for.
Do not add a fifth guard to fix a failure caused by guards

lib/invented-session.ts was written, worked, and was deleted. Her point: 'maybe there's too much architechture around it, limiting it's thinking.' Adding scaffolding to fix scaffolding is how the prompt reached 76,000 characters.
Cut the prompt from measurement, not opinion
Her method, in her order: inventory, then an eval from turns whose answers are known, then cut in passes and re-measure. Three passes shipped, all proved harmless.
A keyword trigger for the app map is not shippable
Measured against 600 real messages: fires on 4%, but skips 'alternative moves but with videos' - that evening's actual failure - while carrying a referral letter and voice tests.
The architectural split waits for daylight
The deciding call does not need the 9,400-character screen map. Real win, but it moves text from cached to uncached and changes how two calls share a prefix. Not a decision to make at midnight.
